description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Pewehera, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District (25-14-204-00012)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and declarations regarding specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about land parcels (numbers, extents, locations, ownership status) and represents an official determination of land titles by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category.
